# Set-ZbxImage

## SYNOPSIS

Changes an image.

## SYNTAX

```
Set-ZbxImage [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixImage>[]> [[-Name] <string>] [-ImageData <string>] [-AdditionalProperty <Hashtable>] [-Force] [-PassThru] [-PipedRecord <PSObject>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

An image is an icon or a background picture that maps and map elements show, stored on the server as PNG data. The Set-ZbxImage cmdlet changes the images given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped objects) with image.update; a field whose parameter is not given keeps its value. Every image the pipeline brings is changed in one call when the pipeline ends, and -AdditionalProperty sets any other field by its API name. The command writes nothing unless -PassThru is given, which reads the changed images back and writes them; -WhatIf shows what would change.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Change an image

```powershell
Set-ZbxImage -InputObject 'Rack' -Name 'Server rack'
```

Renames the image Rack to Server rack.

### Example 2: Change an image and write the result

```powershell
Set-ZbxImage -InputObject 'Rack' -Name 'Server rack' -PassThru
```

The same change with -PassThru, which reads the image Rack back from the server and writes it; without it the command writes nothing.

## INPUTS

- `ZabbixReference<ZabbixImage>[]`: Bound to -InputObject (ByValue). Represents a reference to an API object: a parameter that points at an API object takes its id, its name, or the object itself piped from a Get- cmdlet, and becomes an id before the call — one parameter, three spellings, one resolution.
- `string`: Bound to -Name (ByPropertyName), -ImageData (ByPropertyName). Text.
- `PSObject`: Bound to -PipedRecord (ByValue). Each object as the API answers it.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixImage`: Image class.
